note: BH-8318 (MKF-3). The memory of every pool machine of the project: spawn_one passes it as `--vm-memory` on `fly machine run`. Per-project row `lane.fly-pool.<project>.vm_memory_mb`. It must be a multiple of 1024 and between 2048 and 8192 MB per CPU of VM_SIZE (performance-16x: 32768..131072). A value that breaks the rule launches the WHOLE pair as performance-8x/16384 and logs one `VM size row refused` line per spawn. No row: 16384, the memory before this knob.
